story.summaryZh: 第三车手Jak Crawford带我们了解阿斯顿·马丁F1车队在AMRTC模拟器中的日常，展示车队如何为周末的比赛做准备。
story.originalTitle: Behind every lap is work you don’t always see. Third Driver Jak Crawford takes us through a day in the driver-in-the-loop simulator at the AMRTC, off...
story.summaryEn:
Behind every lap is work you don’t always see.
Third Driver Jak Crawford takes us through a day in the driver-in-the-loop simulator at the AMRTC, offering a closer look at how the team prepares for race weekends.
Read more: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/feature/a-day-in-the-life-with-a-driver-in-the-loop
detailZh:
在每一圈的背后，都有你未必总能看到的努力。
第三车手Jak Crawford带我们走进AMRTC的驾驶员在环模拟器的一天，更近距离地了解车队是如何为周末的赛事做准备。
阅读更多：https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/feature/a-day-in-the-life-with-a-driver-in-the-loop
